name: ldh
description: Build Linked Data dataspaces, datasets and applications on LinkedDataHub with the ldh CLI: provision a dataspace, model and import data, declare documents, views and charts, and write reusable packages

ldh_base.title: LinkedDataHub base URL
ldh_base.description: The end-user base of the dataspace to work on, e.g. https://inventory.localhost:4443/

cert_file.title: WebID certificate
cert_file.description: The owner's WebID keystore, which the linkeddatahub container generates at ssl/owner/keystore.p12 in the LinkedDataHub checkout (ssl/owner/cert.pem works too)

cert_password.title: Certificate password
cert_password.description: The owner certificate's password, the one in secrets/owner_cert_password.txt
